llm.summary: This is mostly a coherent real-estate skill toolkit, but its calculator template loader is under-scoped and can read arbitrary local JSON paths when invoked.

dimensions.detail: skills/calc-toolkit/ruleengine.py allows --template to resolve to an absolute path or fallback existing filesystem path, which exceeds the documented managed template directory and could expose local JSON data if an agent runs it with attacker-influenced input.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: install.sh is an explicit installer that copies a generated skill into common agent skill directories and writes a sha256 marker; this is disclosed and purpose-aligned, but users should choose the target directory deliberately.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Several activation phrases and generated trigger templates are broad, but most are still tied to real-estate skill use, calculation, or branded consulting rather than unrelated agent control.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The package has no background worker or hidden persistence; persistence is limited to installing generated skill files and saving user templates, though template save/load path handling should be constrained.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The stated purpose is a Chinese real-estate AI skill repository with calculators and templates for buyer, broker, developer-sales, and channel workflows; the observed files largely match that purpose.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Review before installing. The toolkit appears intended for real-estate calculations and skill generation, but constrain calculator templates to a dedicated directory before using it in an agent that may act on untrusted prompts. For generated sales or CRM skills, add explicit consent, minimization, retention, and access-control rules for customer information.
llm.findings:
[SDI-2] unexpected: Accepted as a material concern: the template loader reads caller-supplied absolute or fallback paths instead of restricting reads to the managed my_templates directory.
[SQP-2] unexpected: Accepted in part for template loading: arbitrary existing-path fallback is under-disclosed. The CRM dossier concern is purpose-aligned for real-estate follow-up, but should add clearer consent, retention, and storage limits.
[SQP-1] expected: Mostly downgraded: broad real-estate trigger phrases can over-activate, especially in generated examples, but they do not by themselves show hidden or malicious behavior.
[SQP-3] expected: Downgraded: the package is plainly Chinese-market oriented and some templates explicitly say to use the user's language, so this is a usability/localization issue rather than a security concern.
